netlist:
* Spicey Electrons circuit at 20 C
.options rshunt=1e12 reltol=1e-3 method=gear
.temp 20
vam_SQ1 n1 SQ1_am 0
V_SQ1 SQ1_int 0 PULSE(0 5 0 2e-06 2e-06 0.000998 0.002)
R_SQ1_in SQ1_am SQ1_int 0.1
vam_SQ2 n2 SQ2_am 0
V_SQ2 SQ2_int 0 PULSE(0 5 0 1e-06 1e-06 0.000499 0.001)
R_SQ2_in SQ2_am SQ2_int 0.1
vam_G1 n3 G1_am 0
R_G1_i0 n1 0 10Meg
R_G1_i1 n2 0 10Meg
B_G1 G1_x 0 V = 5*((0.5*(1+tanh((v(n1)-2.5)/0.2)))+(0.5*(1+tanh((v(n2)-2.5)/0.2)))-2*(0.5*(1+tanh((v(n1)-2.5)/0.2)))*(0.5*(1+tanh((v(n2)-2.5)/0.2))))
R_G1_d G1_x G1_y 1000
C_G1_d G1_y 0 10p
B_G1_buf G1_o 0 V = v(G1_y)
R_G1_out G1_o G1_am 50
.ic v(G1_y)=0
vam_G2 n4 G2_am 0
R_G2_i0 n1 0 10Meg
R_G2_i1 n2 0 10Meg
B_G2 G2_x 0 V = 5*(0.5*(1+tanh((v(n1)-2.5)/0.2)))*(0.5*(1+tanh((v(n2)-2.5)/0.2)))
R_G2_d G2_x G2_y 1030
C_G2_d G2_y 0 10p
B_G2_buf G2_o 0 V = v(G2_y)
R_G2_out G2_o G2_am 50
.ic v(G2_y)=5
vam_R1 n3 R1_am 0
R_R1 R1_am 0 10000
vam_R2 n4 R2_am 0
R_R2 R2_am 0 10000
.control
set filetype=binary
tran 1e-05 0.01 0 1e-05
write __OUT__ v(n1) v(n2) v(n3) v(n4) i(vam_sq1) i(vam_sq2) i(vam_g1) i(vam_g2) i(vam_r1) i(vam_r2)
quit
.endc
.end
